results.title: Ashleigh Gardner requests privacy amid affair allegations as Cricket Australia retains her as vice-captain
results.description: Ashleigh has been at the center of public scrutiny after her estranged wife, Monica Wright, made serious infidelity allegations regarding events during the 2025 Women's ODI World Cup in India, while also questioning the national board's decision to keep the all-rounder in her vice-captaincy role.

results.title: Lynx nearly squander 29-point lead, hold on for 85-81 win over Fire
results.description: Napheesa Collier had 20 points and nine rebounds, Kayla McBride scored 19 points and the Minnesota Lynx nearly squandered a 29-point lead before holding off the Portland Fire 85-81.
